name: Deploy Docs

# Builds the Astro documentation site and deploys it to Netlify on every push
# to master. The icon assets live in the iconGenerator submodule and are copied
# into ./public/icons by the `prebuild` script before `astro build` runs.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'iconGenerator/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: docs-deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Build and deploy docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: '10'

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: docs/.nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: docs/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Build site
        run: pnpm build
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        uses: nwtgck/actions-netlify@v4
        with:
          publish-dir: docs/dist
          production-deploy: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          deploy-message: 'Deploy from ${{ github.sha }}'
          enable-pull-request-comment: false
          enable-commit-comment: false
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
